metric_definitions.fix_rate: culture-specific clear harmful baseline failures defined by g06; share not Unsafe, Controversial also counted separately

limitations: Interim results; p-values are descriptive until all six chunks are included in both arms.
Single training run per arm (seed 0); EN seed-0 adapter tripped the held-back English helpful over-refusal sanity gate (75%), so EN over-refusal may be high.
Automated guard judgments are not human validation.
Matched results cover only Japan prompts and their exact US counterparts; unpaired US-only prompts are excluded.
For c0001, the 10% US JA-s0 reuse check was 92.91% on unsafe and 100% on refused; the full matched US JA-s0 set was therefore generated in this session.
Some seed-level prompts can be absent from the matched publication; paired tests use only seed_checks paired_ok seeds.
J4 cross-arm results are hardware-mismatched for chunks listed in j4_hardware_mismatched_chunks; both arms used bf16 but different GPUs.
